source_basis.source: TradingView SMC Gold Helper: Dynamic FVG & Liquidity Sweeps
source_basis.logic: Gold-focused 4H liquidity sweeps + FVG + market-structure shift
Gold 4H swing-liquidity sweep -> MSS/CHoCH -> FVG entry zone
4H liquidity/supply anchor -> lower-timeframe CHoCH/BOS -> pullback entry
weekly/daily or higher-timeframe liquidity anchor cited as probability context before LTF displacement/FVG

hypothesis: Replacing S5-local liquidity pools with causally confirmed H1/H4 swing anchors, while preserving the same S5 sweep -> state shift -> FVG -> retrace sequence, will sharply reduce noise without starving opportunity supply.

frozen_ltf_logic.anchor_visibility: higher-timeframe swing visible only after one completed bar to the right
frozen_ltf_logic.sweep: S5 wick strictly violates latest confirmed unswept HTF swing and completed S5 bar closes back inside with reversal color
frozen_ltf_logic.cisd: within 6 completed S5 bars after sweep, close through sweep-bar open in reversal direction
frozen_ltf_logic.fvg: classic 3-bar reversal-direction FVG no earlier than CISD and within 2 S5 bars after CISD
frozen_ltf_logic.retrace: within 6 S5 bars after FVG, range reaches FVG midpoint and completed bar rejects in reversal direction without closing through far edge
frozen_ltf_logic.anchor_consumption: each confirmed HTF swing level may trigger at most one sweep sequence; new confirmed swing creates a new anchor
frozen_ltf_logic.execution: first tick at/after rejection right edge on P75; spread <=25 points

stage_a_gate.survivor_rule: at least one preregistered HTF anchor config must strong-pass before later-January validation
